result.title: TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
result.summary: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved. Visual super-resolution can sharpen these regions without resolving whether the recovered lips and teeth agree with the spoken audio. We present an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that addresses this ambiguity within a reference-guided video flow model. Source--noise mixing initializes reconstruction from a partially preserved observation, and structured reference injection separates appearance anchors from continuous motion context. Training combines restoration of degraded images and videos with correction of degraded dubbed sources under target audio. Appearance and synchronization supervision allow the model to recover facial detail and support visual dubbing when the audio is replaced. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores among the compared restoration methods. Component comparisons examine audio conditioning, the reconstruction formulation, and reference injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage. injection. AI.brief_summary: 提出音频引导的人脸视频修复框架，在参考引导的视频流模型中用源-噪声混合初始化、结构化参考注入分别保留观测与外观/运动信息，并联合外观与同步监督恢复面部细节、支持视觉配音。
AI.relevance_reason: 属视频超分与生成式修复任务，目标是小区域画质与音画同步，不含推理状态生成、证据获取或停止决策；参考注入与观测保留仅是生成条件设计，与 LVR 内部表示和 latent 使用缺少可核查的实质联系。
